Dogleg gallery replaces U-B01/U-B02; U-LB is a landing service wall. Tallmass wing BLD-2-1 splits aroundtheeast gallery leg.
D-01 is an optional unguarded4m drop to supported mid at(48.5,67.5,0). Ordinary gallery route still connects both ends.
T-01/T-04 are7m vestibule returns; BLD-T is a7m controlbuilding core shaping the courtyard and blocking transverse feed views.
A dais has two6m-wide3-riserstairs: Y68..70 up andY77..79 down. A-02 relocates18..21,80..82; A-L01 relocates12..15,68..70.
East saddle: Y40..44 ramp0→1.2; Y44..46 crest; Y46..50 ramp1.2→0. E-L01 sits oncrest atZ1.2; E-02 is an8m attached wing.
